Each height a fraction of the turn before
Gravity gathers what we cannot keep
Slowing the motion toward the dusty floor

A layer of yellow dust is covering it
Unmarked by footsteps in the autumn rain

[Chorus]
And the pendulum slows its steady sweep
Each height a fraction of the turn before
Gravity gathers what we cannot keep
Slowing the motion toward the dusty floor

And the pendulum slows its steady sweep
Each height a fraction of the turn before
Gravity gathers what we cannot keep
Slowing the motion toward the dusty floor

Now all coordinates are frozen stiff
Leaving the empty swing to gravity's cue

[Outro]
Rusted chain links.
Slack lines.
Concrete collar.",

import { ADR, SystemModule, PipelineEvent, Sprint, L2Contract, DnaObject, CreativeIdentity } from "./types";

export const ADR_LIST: ADR[] = [
  {
    id: "ADR-001",
    title: "Why ESS is Event-Driven",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "Suno's dashboard is a dynamic Single Page App. Web requests, socket events, and DOM updates occur asynchronously. If ESS relies on synchronous polling or monolithic loops, it will miss crucial mutations, drift in state, and risk double-processing identical audio clips.",
    decision: "All internal transitions must trigger via immutable, serialized event envelopes broadcasted through a centralized Kernel Bus. Components never invoke each other directly; they register as subscribers to specific system event topics.",
    consequences: "Complete visibility of processing pipelines. Failures can be captured at specific boundary states and safely replayed without risk of duplication or inconsistent filesystem state."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-002",
    title: "Why Metadata is Immutable",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "AI generations are vulnerable to platform deletions, updates, and account policy changes. Prompt texts and generation seeds represent the unique genetic lineage ('Creative DNA') of an asset. If editable, provenance is compromised.",
    decision: "The original generation payload (Seed, Model, Style Prompt, Creation Timestamp) is captured as a Read-Only invariant. Any user enrichment, categorization, or folder nesting is stored as a distinct, layered 'Overlay Ledger' referencing the original Immutable Generation ID.",
    consequences: "Integrity of historical outputs is guaranteed. Downstream analyzers can always trace back to original, uncorrupted generation details even if metadata layers are updated."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-006",
    title: "Track-Centric to Creative-Asset-Centric Shift",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-21",
    context: "Initial designs treated 'Track' as the foundational root node. This tightly coupled ECAM to platform-specific music formats. A track is merely one derivative render of a core creative concept, which also includes prompts, lyrics, artwork, stems, MIDI, and videos.",
    decision: "Refactor root entity modeling to 'Creative Asset'. A single Creative Asset encapsulates parallel outputs (Songs, Prompts, Lyrics, Cover Art, Audio, Remixes, Stems, Notes) mapped to an immutable, provider-agnostic 'Creative Identity'. This decouples the core asset manager from provider-specific variables.",
    consequences: "Universal extensibility. Suno, Udio, Google Flow, or native DAWs operate simply as pluggable ingestion adapters without affecting schema or identity relationships."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-007",
    title: "Introduction of normalized Identity Resolution Layer",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-21",
    context: "Users iterate across dozens of generations, edits, and platform providers for a single work (e.g. Volume II). Treating each as an isolated track creates logical duplication and breaks lineage history.",
    decision: "Introduce an 'Identity Resolver' boundary directly between Normalization and Creative Asset storage. The resolver calculates vector similarities and prompt signatures to associate newly normalized provider files to a single 'Creative Identity' root. All subsequent runs are stored as version overlays in the ledger.",
    consequences: "Automatically relates remixes, alternative takes, and voice notes into a clean, unified version array. Drastically simplifies searching and library export pipelines."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-008",
    title: "Identity Stability & Merge Certificates",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-21",
    context: "As new files are ingested, new evidence may link two previously distinct Creative Identities. Deleting or renaming an Identity breaks external logical references across vaults and sync databases.",
    decision: "A CreativeIdentity UUID must never be altered or destroyed once committed. When a matching link is discovered post-facto, a 'Merge Operation' generates a cryptographically signed 'Merge Certificate'. Identity A remains authoritative; Identity B is marked as a deprecated Alias redirecting to A.",
    consequences: "Absolute reference stability across offline boundaries, network distributed nodes, and local cache indexers."
  }
];

import { ADR, SystemModule, PipelineEvent, Sprint, L2Contract, DnaObject } from "./types";

export const ADR_LIST: ADR[] = [
  {
    id: "ADR-001",
    title: "Why ESS is Event-Driven",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "Suno's dashboard is a dynamic Single Page App. Web requests, socket events, and DOM updates occur asynchronously. If ESS relies on synchronous polling or monolithic loops, it will miss crucial mutations, drift in state, and risk double-processing identical audio clips.",
    decision: "All internal transitions must trigger via immutable, serialized event envelopes broadcasted through a centralized Kernel Bus. Components never invoke each other directly; they register as subscribers to specific system event topics.",
    consequences: "Complete visibility of processing pipelines. Failures can be captured at specific boundary states and safely replayed without risk of duplication or inconsistent filesystem state."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-002",
    title: "Why Metadata is Immutable",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "AI generations are vulnerable to platform deletions, updates, and account policy changes. Prompt texts and generation seeds represent the unique genetic lineage ('Creative DNA') of an asset. If editable, provenance is compromised.",
    decision: "The original generation payload (Seed, Model, Style Prompt, Creation Timestamp) is captured as a Read-Only invariant. Any user enrichment, categorization, or folder nesting is stored as a distinct, layered 'Overlay Ledger' referencing the original Immutable Generation ID.",
    consequences: "Integrity of historical outputs is guaranteed. Downstream analyzers can always trace back to original, uncorrupted generation details even if metadata layers are updated."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-003",
    title: "Why Workspace is Automatic",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "High-volume creators with thousands of tracks cannot scale if they are forced to manually tag, sort, and drag-and-drop every audio clip or lyrics file.",
    decision: "ESS must employ a predictive Rule Engine that analyzes prompt metadata, style characteristics, or timestamp patterns to automatically suggest or assign files to corresponding workspace partitions (e.g. 'Romantic', 'Cinematic Synthpop', 'EDM') upon initial scan.",
    consequences: "Eliminates the cognitive friction of manual tagging. The system maintains clean folder trees automatically while allowing manual override overlays."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-004",
    title: "Why Creative DNA Exists",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "A song is not an isolated file. It is a cluster of mutually dependent artifacts (Audio file, High-Res Cover, Exact Prompt, Model Seed, Lyric timeline, and historical edits). If these files drift apart, the creative context is lost forever.",
    decision: "ESS encapsulates every asset within a standardized 'Creative DNA Bundle'. This bundle binds audio and companion files with an immutable SHA-256 dual-hash signature file representing both the structural specification and execution state.",
    consequences: "Ensures the entire creative constellation can be zipped, exported, backed up, or re-imported to another ESS instance with absolute preservation of state."
  },
  {
    id: "ADR-005",
    title: "Why Asset Acquisition Engine is Stateless",
    status: "ACCEPTED",
    author: "Chief Architect (Elyzareth)",
    date: "2026-07-20",
    context: "Browser download managers are highly volatile, can be paused by OS events, aborted due to connection issues, or canceled by users.",
    decision: "The ESS Asset Acquisition Engine (AAE) must not maintain hidden, local state variables. It reads raw jobs directly from the verified scan queue ledger, verifies current storage file hashes, and emits progress events. If interrupted, the queue simply resumes from the last unverified asset index in the ledger.",
    consequences: "Guarantees complete safety against system crashes or browser restarts. If a download fails halfway, the system resumes with zero metadata corruption."
  }
];

export const ENGINE_CONTRACT = `
# ELYZARETH CREATIVE ENGINE CONTRACT

## I. PURPOSE & MISSION
ELYZARETH is not an assistant; it is a **Witness-Centered Songwriting Framework**. 
Its singular objective is to defend human-authored lyrics from the homogenizing force of AI "Token Gravity" and generic songwriting templates.
This document defines the mathematical, physical, and structural criteria of the ELYZARETH Creative Engine.

---

## II. IMMUTABLE LAWS
1. **The Witness Principle**: Lyrics must observe and reflect physical change (temperatures, weights, structural states) rather than merely labeling emotions.
2. **Anti-Bleed Rule**: No English filler or cliché words may contaminate High-Taste Romanized Hindi/Urdu pieces.
3. **Poetic Tension Over Perfect Rhymes**: Overly predictive rhyme structures (AABB basic) with standard pop vocabularies are treated as potential AI Slop and flagged.
4. **Structure Over Instruction**: Generative models are constrained by rigid architectural formats (e.g., Elyzareth Bible V1.2 4-Line rule).

---

## III. PHYSICAL FAMILY METRICS
We analyze lyrics through 7 core thermodynamic and mechanical metrics:

- **Entropy (H)**: Rate of unexpected word transitions / unpredictability of vocabulary. Goal: High (>0.75)
- **Coherence (C)**: Semantic stability and thematic drift prevention across verses. Goal: High (>0.70)
- **Pressure (P)**: Ratio of concrete physical objects to abstract emotional statements. Goal: High (>0.65)
- **Gain (G)**: Structural acceleration (vocal dynamic load and syllable density shift). Goal: Balanced (0.4-0.8)
- **Memory (M)**: Overlap with existing clichés and structural templates in database. Goal: Low (<0.30)
- **Recovery (R)**: Energy transition rate at structural boundaries (Verse ➔ Chorus). Goal: High (>0.60)
- **Flow Guard (F)**: Absolute rule-compliance score (4-Line rule, vocabulary safety bounds). Goal: Perfect (1.00)

---

## IV. DECISION TREE
The Engine evaluates the metrics above and reaches exactly one of four clinical states:

### 🟢 PASS
* **Criteria**: All core metrics above threshold. Zero Flow Guard violations.
* **Result**: Promoted to Priority Queue for production.

### 🟡 REVISE
* **Criteria**: Minor cliché overlap or structural asymmetry. 
* **Result**: Returned with Clinical Diagnosis pointing exactly to the load-bearing errors.

### 🟠 QUARANTINE
* **Criteria**: Extreme entropy traces or completely unorthodox non-musical structures.
* **Result**: Isolated for Chief Architect review to prevent loss of genius or accidental noise.

### 🔴 REJECT
* **Criteria**: High template bleed, generic pop slop, or structural failure.
* **Result**: Hard lock. Sent to entropy archive.
`;

export default function Component() {
  const [tracks, setTracks] = useState<Track[]>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("elyzareth_album_2_tracks_v15");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : INITIAL_TRACKS;
  });
  
  const [activeTrackId, setActiveTrackId] = useState<number>(1);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"lyrics" | "generator" | "publisher">("lyrics");
  const [selectedAlbum, setSelectedAlbum] = useState<string>("All Albums");
  const [customPrompt, setCustomPrompt] = useState("");
  const [selectedLanguage, setSelectedLanguage] = useState<"English" | "Hindi" | "Hinglish">("English");
  const [generationStyle, setGenerationStyle] = useState<"Heavenly & Pure" | "Grounded Realities" | "Hindi-Urdu Classical" | "Neo-Synthwave">("Grounded Realities");
  const [showToast, setShowToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);

  // Audio Synth Player State
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const audioCtxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const activeOscsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const synthIntervalRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const [playbackProgress, setPlaybackProgress] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("elyzareth_album_2_tracks_v15", JSON.stringify(tracks));
  }, [tracks]);

  const activeTrack = tracks.find(t => t.id === activeTrackId) || tracks[0];

  const triggerToast = (msg: string) => {
    setShowToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setShowToast(null), 3000);
  };

  // Web Audio Synth Engine
  const startSynth = () => {
    try {
      // Stop existing synth first
      if (isPlaying) {
        stopSynth();
      }

      const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
      const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
      audioCtxRef.current = ctx;
      
      // Determine frequency scale based on Key
      let noteFrequencies: number[] = [];
      if (activeTrack.key.includes("E Major")) {
        noteFrequencies = [164.81, 196.00, 220.00, 246.94, 329.63]; // E3, G3, A3, B3, E4
      } else if (activeTrack.key.includes("A Major")) {
        noteFrequencies = [220.00, 277.18, 329.63, 440.00, 554.37]; // A3, C#4, E4, A4, C#5
      } else if (activeTrack.key.includes("D Major")) {
        noteFrequencies = [146.83, 185.00, 220.00, 293.66, 370.01]; // D3, F#3, A3, D4, F#4
      } else if (activeTrack.key.includes("G Major")) {
        noteFrequencies = [196.00, 246.94, 293.66, 392.00, 493.88]; // G3, B3, D4, G4, B4
      } else if (activeTrack.key.includes("B Minor")) {
        noteFrequencies = [123.47, 146.83, 220.00, 246.94, 293.66]; // B2, D3, A3, B3, D4
      } else {
        noteFrequencies = [185.00, 233.08, 277.18, 369.99, 466.16]; // F#3, A#3, C#4, F#4, A#4
      }

      let step = 0;
      const playStep = () => {
        if (!audioCtxRef.current) return;
        const now = audioCtxRef.current.currentTime;
        
        // 1. Cozy Pad Oscillator
        const osc = audioCtxRef.current.createOscillator();
        const gainNode = audioCtxRef.current.createGain();
        osc.type = "triangle";
        const freq = noteFrequencies[step % noteFrequencies.length];
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
        
        gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
        gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.08, now + 0.1);
        gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.8);
        
        osc.connect(gainNode);
        gainNode.connect(audioCtxRef.current.destination);
        osc.start(now);
        osc.stop(now + 0.9);
        activeOscsRef.current.push(osc);
        
        // 2. High Shimmer Pluck
        const pluck = audioCtxRef.current.createOscillator();
        const pluckGain = audioCtxRef.current.createGain();
        pluck.type = "sine";
        pluck.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq * 2, now); // Double octave
        
        pluckGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
        pluckGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.04, now + 0.02);
        pluckGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.4);
        
        pluck.connect(pluckGain);
        pluckGain.connect(audioCtxRef.current.destination);
        pluck.start(now);
        pluck.stop(now + 0.5);
        activeOscsRef.current.push(pluck);

        step++;
        setPlaybackProgress((step % 16) / 15);
      };

      playStep();
      // Approximate timing interval based on tempo bpm (60 / bpm)
      const bpmNum = parseInt(activeTrack.tempo) || 100;
      const intervalMs = (60 / bpmNum) * 1000;
      synthIntervalRef.current = setInterval(playStep, intervalMs);
      setIsPlaying(true);
      triggerToast(`Now playing ambient preview synth in ${activeTrack.key}!`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Audio synthesis initialization failed:", err);
    }
  };

  const stopSynth = () => {
    if (synthIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(synthIntervalRef.current);

      let text = "";
      if (typeof res === "string") {
        text = res;
      } else if (res && typeof res === "object") {
        text = (res as any).lyrics || (res as any).text || (res as any).content || "";
      }

      if (!text || text.trim().length < 10) {
        throw new Error("SDK response empty or insufficient");
      }

      // Parse the SDK response
      const parsedLyrics: Record<string, string[]> = { ...activeTrack.lyrics };
      const blocks = text.split(/\[(.*?)\]/);
      let activeSectionKey = "";

      for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
        const item = blocks[i].trim();
        if (!item) continue;

        const lower = item.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.includes("intro")) {
          activeSectionKey = "intro";
        } else if (lower.includes("verse 1") || lower.includes("verse1")) {
          activeSectionKey = "v1";
        } else if (lower.includes("verse 2") || lower.includes("verse2")) {
          activeSectionKey = "v2";
        } else if (lower.includes("verse 3") || lower.includes("verse3")) {
          activeSectionKey = "v3";
        } else if (lower.includes("verse 4") || lower.includes("verse4")) {
          activeSectionKey = "v4";
        } else if (lower.includes("chorus")) {
          activeSectionKey = "chorus";
        } else if (lower.includes("bridge")) {
          activeSectionKey = "bridge";
        } else if (lower.includes("outro")) {
          activeSectionKey = "outro";
        } else if (activeSectionKey) {
          const lines = item.split("\n")
            .map(line => line.trim())
            .filter(line => line.length > 0)
            .slice(0, 4);
          
          if (lines.length > 0) {
            parsedLyrics[activeSectionKey] = lines;
            while (parsedLyrics[activeSectionKey].length < 4) {
              parsedLyrics[activeSectionKey].push("");
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Check if we populated at least 3 sections
      const populatedCount = Object.keys(parsedLyrics).filter(k => parsedLyrics[k]?.some(l => l.trim().length > 0)).length;

        // Fallback to strict structural parser
        const linearLines = text.split("\n").map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l.length > 0 && !l.startsWith("["));

        ["intro", "v1", "chorus", "v2", "v3", "v4", "bridge", "outro"].forEach(secId => {

          const lines = linearLines.slice(cursor, cursor + 4);

            parsedLyrics[secId] = lines;
            while (parsedLyrics[secId].length < 4) parsedLyrics[secId].push("");

              {filteredTracks.map((track, i) => {
                const isActive = track.id === activeTrackId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={track.id}
                    onClick={() => setActiveTrackId(track.id)}
                    className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 border flex items-center justify-between group ${
                      isActive 
                        ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-zinc-900 to-zinc-900/40 border-amber-500/50 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.05)]" 
                        : "bg-zinc-900/30 hover:bg-zinc-900/60 border-zinc-900 hover:border-zinc-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                      <div className={`w-7.5 h-7.5 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[11px] font-bold ${
                        isActive 
                          ? "bg-amber-500 text-black shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20" 
                          : "bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 group-hover:bg-zinc-700"
                      }`}>
                        {track.id < 10 ? `0${track.id}` : track.id}
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <h4 className={`text-xs font-semibold truncate ${isActive ? "text-white" : "text-zinc-300"}`}>
                          {track.title}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono truncate">
                          {track.album} • {track.key}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-1">
                      <span className={`text-[8px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${
                        track.status === "Complete" 
                          ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20"
                          : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20"
                      }`}>
                        {track.status}
                      </span>
                      <ChevronRight className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-600 transition-transform ${isActive ? "translate-x-0.5 text-amber-500" : ""}`} />
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Engine presets */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 rounded-2xl p-4">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wider text-zinc-400 font-mono uppercase mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" /> Style Directives
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block mb-1">LYRICS LANGUAGE</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 bg-black/60 p-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800">
                  {(["English", "Hindi", "Hinglish"] as const).map(lang => (
                    <button
                      key={lang}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedLanguage(lang);
                        setTracks(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === activeTrack.id ? { ...t, language: lang } : t));
                        triggerToast(`Switched language setting to ${lang}`);
                      }}
                      className={`text-[10px] py-1 rounded-md font-mono transition-all ${
                        activeTrack.language === lang 
                          ? "bg-amber-500 text-black font-bold" 
                          : "text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {lang}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block mb-1">COMPOSITION DIRECTIVE</label>
                <select
                  value={generationStyle}
                  onChange={(e) => setGenerationStyle(e.target.value as any)}
                  className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-mono text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                >
                  <option value="Grounded Realities">Grounded Realities (No Cliche)</option>
                  <option value="Heavenly & Pure">Heavenly & Pure</option>
                  <option value="Hindi-Urdu Classical">Hindi-Urdu Classical</option>
                  <option value="Neo-Synthwave">Neo-Synthwave</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-amber-500/5 border border-amber-500/10 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-semibold block mb-0.5">Elyzareth OS V9/V10 Structure Rule:</span>
                Enforces precise 4-line blocks for every section. Keeps composition organic, emotionally mature, and directly compliant with Flow engine vocals.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center/Right Panel: Workspace Tabs & Editors (8 Cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col gap-4">
          {/* Editor Header / Tab Switcher */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-500">
                <Music className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-md font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  Track {activeTrack.id}: "{activeTrack.title}"
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono italic truncate max-w-[320px]">
                  {activeTrack.theme}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={isPlaying ? stopSynth : startSynth}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                      isPlaying
                        ? "bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.15)]"
                        : "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/20"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isPlaying ? (
                      <>
                        <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400 fill-red-400" /> Stop Preview
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 fill-emerald-400" /> Play Preview
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                  {isPlaying && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-black/40 border border-zinc-850 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
                      <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                      <span>{activeTrack.key} @ {activeTrack.tempo}</span>
                      <div className="flex gap-0.5 ml-2 h-3.5 items-end">
                        <span className="w-0.5 bg-amber-500 animate-bounce" style={{ height: "60%", animationDelay: "0.1s" }}></span>
                        <span className="w-0.5 bg-amber-500 animate-bounce" style={{ height: "100%", animationDelay: "0.3s" }}></span>
                        <span className="w-0.5 bg-amber-500 animate-bounce" style={{ height: "40%", animationDelay: "0.5s" }}></span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Tab navigation */}
            <div className="flex bg-zinc-900/60 p-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800">
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveTab("lyrics")}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition-all ${
                  activeTab === "lyrics" 
                    ? "bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow" 
                    : "text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Lyrics Studio
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveTab("generator")}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition-all ${
                  activeTab === "generator" 
                    ? "bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow" 
                    : "text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" /> AI Expand
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveTab("publisher")}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition-all ${
                  activeTab === "publisher" 
                    ? "bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow" 
                    : "text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> YT Publisher
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* TAB 1: LYRICS BUILDER */}
          {activeTab === "lyrics" && (
            <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-900 pb-4">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                    Structure Blocks <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-500 font-normal">4-Line Mode</span>
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">Edit exact lines. Repeat elements auto-sync seamlessly.</p>
                </div>
                
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={cleanAndCompress}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-850 border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" /> Clean & Compress
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleExport}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-black rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/15"
                  >
                    <Download className="w-3 h-3" /> Export Text
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Core interactive block sections */}
              <div className="space-y-6 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-2 custom-scrollbar">
                {STRUCTURE_SECTIONS.map((sec) => {
                  const baseSecId = sec.id.replace(/_repeat_\d+/, "");
                  const lines = activeTrack.lyrics[baseSecId] || ["", "", "", ""];
                  const isChorusRepeat = sec.id !== "chorus" && sec.id.startsWith("chorus");
                  
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={sec.id} 
                      className={`p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                        isChorusRepeat 
                          ? "bg-zinc-950/40 border-zinc-900/40 opacity-70" 
                          : "bg-zinc-900/20 border-zinc-900 focus-within:border-amber-500/30"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className={`text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md ${
                            sec.type === "Chorus" ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20" :
                            sec.type === "Bridge" ? "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20" :
                            "bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-700/50"
                          }`}>
                            {sec.label}
                          </span>
                          {isChorusRepeat && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono italic">
                              (Synced with main Chorus)
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-600">Exactly 4 lines</span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((idx) => (
                          <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-600 w-4 text-right">0{idx + 1}</span>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={lines[idx] || ""}
                              placeholder={`Line ${idx + 1}...`}
                              disabled={isChorusRepeat}
                              onChange={(e) => handleLineChange(baseSecId, idx, e.target.value)}
                              className={`w-full bg-black/40 border rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-700 focus:outline-none focus:bg-black/60 transition-all ${
                                isChorusRepeat 
                                  ? "border-zinc-900/20 text-zinc-500 italic" 
                                  : "border-zinc-900 focus:border-amber-500/40"
                              }`}
                            />
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: AI LYRICS EXPANSION */}
          {activeTab === "generator" && (
            <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="border-b border-zinc-900 pb-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 animate-pulse" /> Complete Elyzareth OS Lyric Composer
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-1">
                  Expand the selected track into a complete 11-block masterpiece instantly adhering to your custom template.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                <div className="bg-zinc-900/30 border border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-xl">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold">CURRENT SEED LYRIC DETECTED</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">Found in track model data</span>
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Show whichever seed lyric Jathang provided */}
                  <div className="bg-black/50 border border-zinc-800 p-3.5 rounded-lg font-mono text-xs text-amber-500/90 leading-relaxed italic">
                    {activeTrack.lyrics.v1 ? (
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono not-italic block mb-1">[Verse 1 Fragment]</span>
                        {activeTrack.lyrics.v1.join("\n")}
                      </div>
                    ) : activeTrack.lyrics.chorus ? (
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono not-italic block mb-1">[Chorus Fragment]</span>
                        {activeTrack.lyrics.chorus.join("\n")}
                      </div>
                    ) : activeTrack.lyrics.bridge ? (
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono not-italic block mb-1">[Bridge Fragment]</span>
                        {activeTrack.lyrics.bridge.join("\n")}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      "No seed fragment found. Please add one in the editor first."
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-zinc-900/20 border border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-xl space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold block mb-2">ADD ADDITIONAL CREATIVE PROMPTS (OPTIONAL)</span>
                    <textarea
                      value={customPrompt}
                      onChange={(e) => setCustomPrompt(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Include metaphors of warm silver rains, keep the style deep, classical Urdu depth, etc..."
                      rows={3}
                      className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-zinc-900 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
                    <div className="bg-black/40 border border-zinc-800 p-3 rounded-lg flex flex-col justify-between">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block mb-1">SELECTED CONFIGURATION</span>
                      <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white space-y-1">
                        <div>Style: <span className="text-amber-400">{generationStyle}</span></div>
                        <div>Language: <span className="text-amber-400">{activeTrack.language}</span></div>
                        <div>Architecture: <span className="text-emerald-400">11-Block Strict Rule</span></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <button
                      onClick={generateRestOfTrack}
                      className="w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-yellow-600 hover:from-amber-600 hover:to-yellow-700 text-black font-extrabold rounded-xl py-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-xl shadow-amber-500/10 group"
                    >
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider font-black">
                        <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-black group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" /> Compose Full Track
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] opacity-75 font-mono">ENFORCE ALL 44 LINES PERFECTLY</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: YOUTUBE PUBLISHER METADATA SUITE */}
          {activeTab === "publisher" && (
            <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="border-b border-zinc-900 pb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" /> Elyzareth YouTube Publisher Suite
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-1">
                    Manage session keys, high-grade metadata rendering, and video parameters.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-zinc-400">
                  SYSTEM STATUS: SECURED
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="bg-zinc-900/20 border border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-xl space-y-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold block">FLOW GUARD SECURE METADATA</span>
                  
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[9px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block mb-1">SESSION ENGINE ID</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={activeTrack.sessionId}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        setTracks(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === activeTrack.id ? { ...t, sessionId: val } : t));
                      }}
                      className="w-full bg-black border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-mono text-amber-500"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[9px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block mb-1">FLOW GUARD COMPLIANCE TOKEN</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={activeTrack.flowGuardToken}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        setTracks(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === activeTrack.id ? { ...t, flowGuardToken: val } : t));
                      }}
                      className="w-full bg-black border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-zinc-900/20 border border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold block mb-2">PUBLISHING ASSET PREVIEW</span>
                    <div className="bg-black border border-zinc-850 p-3 rounded-lg space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
                      <div><span className="text-zinc-500">Video Title:</span> <span className="text-white">Elyzareth - {activeTrack.title} ({activeTrack.album})</span></div>
                      <div><span className="text-zinc-500">Lyrics Length:</span> <span className="text-amber-400">{formatFullLyrics(activeTrack).split("\n").filter(Boolean).length} lines</span></div>
                      <div><span className="text-zinc-500">Aspect Ratio:</span> <span className="text-white">16:9 Cinematic UHD</span></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-3">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => triggerToast("All publishing tokens bound and synchronized!")}
                      className="bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-850 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 py-2 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono transition-all"
                    >
                      Sync & Validate
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        triggerToast("Generating YouTube Asset Bundle... Cover art preview & high-taste SEO tags completed!");
                        // Dynamically append visual asset tags for Jathang's publisher UI
                      }}
                      className="bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-black py-2 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold transition-all shadow-md shadow-amber-500/10"
                    >
                      Generate Assets
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* YouTube Description Template Generator */}
              <div className="bg-zinc-900/30 border border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-xl grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
                <div className="md:col-span-8">
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold block mb-2">AUTO-GENERATED YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION</span>
                  <textarea
                    readOnly
                    value={`🎹 Title: ${activeTrack.title}\n💿 Album: ${activeTrack.album}\n🌟 Framework: Elyzareth OS v9.0\n🔑 Session ID: ${activeTrack.sessionId}\n🛡️ Flow Guard Security: Approved\n\n--- LYRICS ---\n\n${formatFullLyrics(activeTrack)}`}
                    rows={6}
                    className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-zinc-850 rounded-lg p-3 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 font-bold block mb-2">SEO METADATA & TAGS</span>
                    <div className="bg-black/60 border border-zinc-850 rounded-lg p-3 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 leading-relaxed max-h-[110px] overflow-y-auto">
                      #elyzareth #synthwave #ambient #dreamwave #conceptalbum #{activeTrack.title.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "")} #groundedrealities #lofi
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 border-t border-zinc-900 pt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> SEO Optimization Active
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating System Status Toast */}
      {showToast && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-zinc-900 border border-amber-500/40 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono z-50 animate-bounce">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          <span>{showToast}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface YTDesign {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  object: string;
  vibe: string;
  thumbnailPrompt: string;
  cinemagraphLoop: string;
  diaryQuote: string;
  descriptionText: string;
  tags: string[];
  hashtags: string[];
}

export const ytDesigns: YTDesign[] = [
  {
    id: "ELYZ-001",
    title: "Leftover Pizza (Half-Eaten Slice)",
    object: "A half-eaten pizza slice in a paper box",
    vibe: "Physical void & starved love",
    thumbnailPrompt: "A high-angle, minimalist shot of an open, plain brown cardboard pizza box resting on a grey slate kitchen counter at 3 AM. Inside is a single, cold, half-eaten slice of pizza.
